Lake Tinaroo is a rural locality in the Tablelands Region of Queensland, Australia. In the , Lake Tinaroo had "no people or a very low population".
Geography
The locality includes the lake itself (also called Lake Tinaroo) created by the Tinaroo Dam as well as the foreshores of the lake and some of the creeks that flow into the lake. It is mostly a water locality with very little land.
